title: Scoreboard
prompt:
**Description:** A contest has n participants, each with a score. Print
participants in **descending score order; ties keep input order** — and
for each, print `name score`.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 10^5). Next n lines: name (single word,
<= 20 chars) and score s (0 <= s <= 10^9).
**Output:** n lines: `name score`, scoreboard order.

**Example:** `3` / `trang 50` / `binh 80` / `an 50` -> `binh 80` /
`trang 50` / `an 50` (trang before an: input order).

reverse input
all tie
